metadata.title: Collaboration Core

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for operating shared digital collaboration environments that preserve trust, accountability, and appropriate boundaries between participants.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Collaboration platforms, shared workspaces, messaging backplanes, conferencing services, and collaborative content systems.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Foundational pattern defining baseline trust assumptions required for any collaboration system, independent of modality.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Collaboration systems frequently interconnect participants, identities, and content across organizational and trust boundaries, requiring explicit responsibility and trust definition.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Collaboration commonly involves remote and unmanaged endpoints, requiring identity, boundary, and accountability guarantees.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Real-time and near-real-time collaboration inherits many of the same identity and trust risks present in voice and multimedia communication systems.

metadata.remarks: Collaboration Core defines the universal trust properties required for shared digital collaboration environments. These invariants apply regardless of modality (messaging, meetings, file sharing, or workspaces) and establish identity context, participation boundaries, observability, and lifecycle awareness as non-negotiable foundations. This pattern exists to prevent collaboration tools from becoming ungoverned trust zones.

components.title: Collaboration Identity Context Awareness
components.description: Ensures participant identities, roles, and authority signals are consistently visible and interpretable in collaboration contexts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Masquerading through misleading identity presentation in collaboration environments.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of valid accounts to misrepresent authority or intent during collaboration.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Strong identity binding and attribution mitigate impersonation across collaboration modalities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Participants in collaboration systems are authenticated and attributable.
Identity attributes are managed to ensure correct role and context representation.

components.title: Collaboration Boundary and Membership Control
components.description: Constrains who may join, observe, or persist within collaboration spaces.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted relationships through unauthorized or over-extended collaboration membership.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Membership and role-based access control enforce collaboration boundaries.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Access to collaboration environments is explicitly managed and reviewed.

components.title: Collaboration Accountability and Observability
components.description: Provides visibility and traceability into collaboration activity for governance and investigation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Deletion or suppression of evidence related to collaboration misuse.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and activity tracing support accountability across collaboration systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Collaboration events are defined and logged.
Audit review supports oversight and investigation of collaboration activity.

components.title: Collaboration Lifecycle Awareness
components.description: Manages creation, evolution, and retirement of collaboration spaces and artifacts.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Persistence and information collection through abandoned or unmanaged collaboration spaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Lifecycle governance reduces residual risk from stale collaboration resources.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Unnecessary or unmanaged collaboration functionality is reduced.
Policies define lifecycle expectations for collaboration environments.
